saveTriggers.when: after a settings control commits, not on every input event
when the player confirms a car, map or mode
once per FINISH event, after the result panel has the final time
after the ghost store accepted a faster clean run
after the player confirms the reset dialog

quota-exceeded.message: Progress could not be saved: browser storage is full.
quota-exceeded.detail: Free space or export the profile, then retry. The current session keeps the new values.

storage-unavailable.message: This browser is blocking local storage; progress will not survive a reload.
storage-unavailable.detail: Private mode or a storage policy is blocking writes.

saved-memory.message: Progress is kept for this session only.
saved-memory.detail: The save reached memory but not durable storage.

future-schema.message: This profile was written by a newer build and was not loaded.
future-schema.detail: Update the game; this build will not overwrite the newer profile.

read-only.message: The profile is read-only because it could not be recovered safely.
read-only.detail: A backup is required before any reset or overwrite.

corrupt-json.message: The saved profile was damaged and has been reset. A backup was kept.
corrupt-json.detail: The damaged bytes are in the backup key reported by load().

invalid-schema.message: The saved profile had an unsupported shape and has been reset. A backup was kept.
invalid-schema.detail: The damaged bytes are in the backup key reported by load().

backup-failed.message: The profile could not be backed up, so it was not overwritten.
backup-failed.detail: Free storage space before retrying the save or reset.

invalid-profile.message: The game produced an invalid profile and the save was refused.
invalid-profile.detail: This is a programming error; the stored profile is untouched.

rules: The profile stores a pointer (file, SHA-256, canonical ghost hash, layout hash, time, ticks), never the ghost payload.
A reference record is only valid after the consumer re-hashes the file bytes against the index sha256 and re-hashes the decoded record against ghostHash.
A local ghost is read from the existing per-course ghost store; the profile never duplicates its base64 sample payload.
A ghost whose layoutHash differs from the active layout is rejected, not replayed.
If no ghost is available the record keeps ghost:null; the UI says so instead of guessing a pose.
